claims.claim: Amazon's Q2 2026 Form 10-Q reports principal contractual commitments of $650.034 billion at June 30, 2026, up from $569.280 billion at March 31, 2026; leases not yet commenced rose to $137.214 billion from $106.347 billion and unconditional purchase obligations rose to $130.065 billion from $103.768 billion.

Amazon also entered a $17.5 billion senior unsecured delayed-draw term-loan facility on June 8, 2026. These source-addressed obligations make capital intensity and financing capacity concrete execution-risk inputs, while not by themselves establishing that the investment program will underperform.

risks: rapid growth in contractual capital commitments increases fixed/committed cash obligations during the AI infrastructure buildout
higher debt and long-dated infrastructure commitments raise the importance of utilization and return-on-invested-capital realization
resource and supply volatility, including memory chips and energy, can affect cost and timing of committed infrastructure expansion
unknowns: portion of June 30 contractual commitments directly attributable to AI/AWS infrastructure
realized return profile and utilization of capacity funded by these commitments
falsifiers: sustained operating cash generation and utilization growth materially outpace commitment growth and restore free-cash-flow resilience
disclosures show committed capacity is substantially customer-backed with attractive realized returns and limited balance-sheet strain
